title: Women’s Health in Midlife and Beyond
address: Kolschowsky Research and Education Institute at SMH, 1880 Arlington St., Sarasota
audience: Women of color and community members interested in midlife wellness.
summary: An open conversation for women of color on menopause, hormones, breast cancer, osteoporosis, and midlife wellness.
description: Presented by A Sheila Bruce Affair, this community panel focused on the unique health issues women of color face regarding menopause, hormones, breast cancer, and osteoporosis. The event included healthcare panelists, light breakfast, presentations, and Q&A.
ticketInfo: Free and open to the public.
